name: celebrate
title: Celebrate
description: Small, one-time moments for something the player earned: a streak that hits a milestone, a perfect round, a right answer. `Celebrate` wraps the thing that earned it and, each time `play` changes, sends a short burst of rays and a ring out from it.…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/celebrate

Installed to `components/ui/effects/celebrate.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/effects/celebrate';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/celebrate

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
